title: GTM Growth Manager
description: Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.” At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month. We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in practice, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics. About the role Developers find us, install the SDK, and start processing audio before we ever speak to them. Thousands of accounts have run audio through our models. Some become customers, but many sit somewhere between a first test and real production use. The opportunity is to identify the accounts with real potential, understand what moves them from testing to paying, and find what makes them grow from there. You own that journey, from reaching promising developers and teams to converting and growing them. You use product and usage data to decide where to focus, get involved in promising evaluations early, and close startup and mid-market deals. You also experiment with outbound approaches to reach new prospects, identify ways to expand existing customers, and build and test the pricing and operational systems that make the whole motion work. This isn't a conventional sales role or a RevOps role. It is a job for someone who wants to do both. If you only want to close, this will frustrate you. If you only want to analyse, you'll be uncomfortable when a number depends on you picking up the phone. Tasks Signup to paid — Carry the conversion number. Work out which trials are real, get into the evaluation early, cut time-to-value, and remove what's blocking the purchase. Outbound — Own the motion end to end: target lists, sequencing, messaging, cadence, and the tooling. Run experiments and double down on what converts. Full-cycle sales — Run startup and mid-market deals end to end: discovery, qualification, technical evaluation, pricing, negotiation, close. Expansion and retention — Own NRR. Most start on one model and a fraction of their traffic. Find the next use case, catch the accounts going quiet before they churn, win back the ones that left. Account intelligence — Build the scoring layer. Turn usage data into a ranked list, and keep the ICP current as the market moves. Rev ops and reporting — Own HubSpot, the funnel model and the monthly numbers. You keep them accurate because we make decisions from them, and everyone from the board down reads the numbers you produce. description: Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “ teaching machines to hear like human beings. ” At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like PolyAI, LiveKit, Telnyx, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month. We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. title: Growth Lead Creator
description: Intro We believe talent is everywhere. The chance to live from it isn't. Millions of creators are talented and invisible at the same time. The value they create flows to middlemen, while the brands who want to reach them are stuck in a non-transparent, fragmented market. So we built the tools to fix both sides at once. Creators turn an account into an income: join a campaign in minutes, make something they're proud of, and get paid fairly for creativity, not follower count. Brands brief once, activate hundreds of creators, and see content live within 24 hours. Next year, 10,000 creators will make a living from WePush. When a creator earns, a brand grows. When a brand grows, more creators earn. WePush is the fastest-growing creator marketing platform in Europe, with over 150,000 creators and 500,000+ collaborations powering brands like L'Oréal, ABOUT YOU, Zalando, and Sony Music. Two numbers matter to us: how many people make a living through WePush, and how many millions of people brands reach through them. The role: Getting from 150,000 creators on the platform to 10,000 creators living from it is a growth problem, and it's yours. You own the creator side of our marketplace end to end: how creators find us, how fast they book their first campaign, and why they keep coming back. We're looking for a Growth Lead who thinks in equations, not channels: someone who can break creator growth into its parts, find the one term that's holding the rest back, and move it. You report directly to the founders. DACH is the starting point, and international expansion begins in Q1. Tasks What you'll do: Take our creator funnel apart, from first touch to signup, first booking, and repeat bookings, and tell us where the leverage is and where we're leaking Bulk of your time: Run growth experiments, kill the losers fast, and scale the winners Own the creator numbers: acquisition and CAC, retention rate, booking speed, booked revenue and all other relevant creator growth metrics. Build and run lifecycle and email marketing that gets creators activated, booked, and back for the next campaign Oversee performance marketing for creator acquisition, with your own budget logic and a clear view of what a creator is worth Work closely with product: onboarding, activation, and everything that decides whether a creator books in minutes or drops off Turn what works into playbooks that hold up outside DACH, so launching the next market is a rollout, not a restart Build creator events as a growth channel, similar to what we do for advertisers with"The30"(the30berlin.com) Every initiative starts with a hypothesis, an expected outcome, and a number that decides whether it live. You measure outcomes, not activity. Requirements You're a strong fit if.. You've founded a company or led growth at a startup or scale-up, and you can show what you moved: the metric, the starting point, and where you left it You're a numbers person first. You build your own analysis, you're at home in SQL or a serious spreadsheet, and you don't wait for a dashboard to exist before forming an opinion You find bottlenecks for a living: given a funnel, you can say which step is worth fixing and which ones are a distraction You're a real allrounder across analytics, email and lifecycle marketing, and performance marketing, and you've done each of them hands-on, not just briefed an agency You understand product well enough to know when the fix is a campaign and when it's a change to the onboarding flow High agency and full ownership: you treat the creator funnel like your own P&L, and you'd rather ship a test today than present a strategy next month Fluent English, ideally German too, since DACH is where we start. Ideally you also know the creator economy from the inside Not expected: A specific number of years on your CV. We care about what you built and what you moved, not how long it took you to get here A background in creator or influencer marketing. Strong growth people learn the market
